programs.title: Accounts Operator Practical Training
programs.shortDescription: Master live day-to-day business accounting entries, sales billing, purchase registers, capital expenditure, e-way bills, e-invoices, and party balance monitoring.
programs.detailedDescription: The Accounts Operator program is meticulously structured for commerce students, fresh graduates, and junior accountants. Unlike theoretical book-keeping, this course simulates a live corporate accounts department. You will record actual bills, process vendor invoices, account for capital investments versus revenue expenditures, generate government-mandated E-way bills and E-invoices, manage transportation and freight entries, and reconcile vendor and customer ledgers on a daily live basis.
programs.eligibility: Class 12th Commerce, B.Com, BBA, or anyone aspiring to start an accounting career
programs.batchTiming: Morning: 8:30 AM – 10:30 AM | Evening: 5:00 PM – 7:00 PM
programs.certificateInfo: YLCC Verified Accounts Operator Certification upon practical ledger evaluation

modules.title: Day-to-Day Business Accounting Entries
topics: Recording live voucher entries (Receipt, Payment, Journal, Contra)
Debit Note & Credit Note workflows with tax adjustments
Sales Billing with HSN/SAC codes and trade discount mechanics
Purchase entries, freight inward, and supplier terms

modules.title: Revenue vs Capital Expenditure Accounting
topics: Differentiating capital investment, revenue expenditure, and deferred revenue expenses
Asset acquisition entries and depreciation schedules
Transportation & logistics bill bookings
Live feeding and verification against physical purchase orders

modules.title: Statutory Invoicing & Balances Tracking
topics: E-way Bill generation, cancellation, and vehicle updating
E-invoicing workflow for B2B and B2G supplies
Party balances reconciliation and monthly confirmation statements
Stock view, godown transfers, and physical stock tally

learningOutcomes: Independent capability to handle sales and purchase desks in any trading or manufacturing firm
Flawless generation of statutory E-way bills and E-invoices on the government portal
Accurate handling of live cash, bank, supplier, and customer ledger entries
Confidence to maintain error-free books of accounts from day one on the job

programs.title: Accounts Manager Professional Program
programs.shortDescription: Supervise books of accounts, control debtors/creditors cycles, monitor sales teams, conduct monthly internal audits, and prepare annual income-tax audits.
programs.detailedDescription: Designed for senior accountants, commerce graduates, and entrepreneurs, the Accounts Manager program prepares you to lead an accounting department. You learn how to scrutinize books of accounts on a live basis, implement strict credit control on debtors cycles, track supplier payment aging, conduct monthly internal accounting audits, inspect negative cash and stock balances, and prepare finalized financial statements for annual income-tax audit filings.

programs.batchTiming: Morning: 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM | Weekend Executive Batch
programs.certificateInfo: YLCC Executive Accounts Management Diploma with Audit Capstone Review

modules.title: Supervision of Day-to-Day Accounting & Books

Scrutiny of general ledger, nominal accounts, and trial balance
Negative ledger monitoring and negative cash balance alerts
Bank reconciliation review and outstanding stale cheque tracking

modules.title: Debtors & Creditors Cycle Management
topics: Debtors cycle analysis and collection period-wise tracking (30, 60, 90+ days)

Sales team monitoring: tracking targets, collections, and commission payouts

modules.title: Inventory Control & Audit Finalization

Advanced receivable and payable aging analysis to protect business working capital
Thorough preparation for statutory auditor visits and Income Tax audit compliance

programs.title: Banking Operations, CC Limits & CMA Preparation
programs.shortDescription: Prepare comprehensive bank limit documents (CC/OD limits), monthly drawing power (DP) calculations, stock statements, and projected balance sheets.
programs.detailedDescription: Every expanding business relies on commercial bank funding—Cash Credit (CC) limits, Overdraft (OD) limits, and Working Capital term loans. This specialized course trains you in the exact banking paperwork demanded by nationalized and private banks. You will prepare bank loan sanction dossiers, compute monthly Drawing Power (DP) statements with margin deduction, compile CMA data (Credit Monitoring Arrangement), and prepare projected Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss statements for limit renewals.
programs.eligibility: Commerce graduates, accountants, finance executives, business owners
programs.batchTiming: Evening: 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM | Saturday & Sunday Special Batch
programs.certificateInfo: YLCC Certified Commercial Banking & Credit Documentation Specialist

modules.title: Working Capital & Bank Limit Sanctions

Complete document checklist for fresh bank limit sanction applications
Collateral security documentation, hypothecation deeds, and guarantor affidavits
KYC and financial ratio benchmarks required by bank credit officers

modules.title: Monthly Drawing Power (DP) Maintenance
topics: Drawing Power formula: Paid stock + eligible book debts minus margin
Drafting and validating monthly Bank Stock Statements
Debtors aging scrutiny for DP eligibility (less than 90 days criteria)
Bank inspection readiness and stock physical verification reconciliation

modules.title: CMA Data & Projected Balance Sheet Preparation
topics: Preparation of 12-page CMA format (Operating statement, balance sheet analysis, fund flow)
Projected Balance Sheet & Profit & Loss statements for annual limit renewal
Current Ratio, Debt-Equity Ratio, and DSCR computation and compliance
Handling bank query letters and credit committee representations

learningOutcomes: Ability to independently prepare monthly bank stock and book-debt statements for DP maintenance

programs.title: GST Practitioner Practical Masterclass
programs.shortDescription: Comprehensive hands-on training in GST Act transaction entries, E-way bill, E-invoicing, monthly GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B filing, GSTR-2B ITC reconciliation, and GSTR-9 audit preparation.
programs.detailedDescription: Goods and Services Tax is the backbone of Indian commercial compliance. This practical masterclass teaches you how to record daily transactions per GST laws, generate E-way bills and E-invoices, file monthly GSTR-1 return data, conduct deep Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation between GSTR-2B and company purchase books, file GSTR-3B with tax offset calculations, and prepare working papers for annual GST returns (GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C). Includes real case studies across trading, manufacturing, and service businesses.
programs.eligibility: Commerce students, tax practitioners, accountants, business operators
programs.batchTiming: Morning: 7:30 AM – 9:30 AM | Evening: 6:30 PM – 8:30 PM
programs.certificateInfo: YLCC Certified Practical GST Practitioner Credentials

topics: Recording intrastate and interstate sales & purchases (CGST, SGST, IGST, RCM)
E-way bill portal operations, multi-vehicle updates, and consignor-consignee rules
E-invoicing: IRN generation, QR code validation, and B2B/Export invoices
Credit note, debit note, and GST rate change adjustments

modules.title: Monthly Return Filing & ITC 2B Reconciliation
topics: Monthly GSTR-1 live preparation: B2B, B2C Large/Small, Export, HSN summary
ITC reconciliation: Matching GSTR-2B with Purchase Ledger (Book Milan)
Handling mismatched, missed, and ineligible ITC per Rule 37A and Section 16(4)
GSTR-3B preparation, tax liability calculation, ITC utilization, and PMT-06 challans

modules.title: Annual GST Returns & Audit Preparation
topics: Annual GSTR-9 filing preparation and table-by-table data compilation
Reconciliation with audited financial statements (GSTR-9C readiness)
Handling GST departmental notices, demand letters, and reply drafting
End-to-end practical GST multi-business project execution

learningOutcomes: Flawless monthly return filing for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B across multiple business clients
Bulletproof ITC reconciliation between portal data (GSTR-2B) and accounting records
Ability to prepare annual GSTR-9 data tables without departmental discrepancies
Confidence to handle day-to-day GST queries and portal workflows independently

programs.title: TDS & TCS Practitioner Practical Course
programs.shortDescription: Master transaction recording according to TDS/TCS provisions, monthly portal payments (Challan 281), quarterly return filing (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q, 27EQ), and Form 16/16A certificate generation.
programs.detailedDescription: Withholding tax compliance is mandatory for every business entity in India. Non-compliance invites hefty interest and penalties. In this course, you will learn section-wise transaction recording under TDS (194C contractor, 194J professional fees, 194I rent, 194Q purchase of goods) and TCS (206C(1H) scrap/goods sale). You will execute monthly tax payments on the Protean/NSDL tax portal, prepare quarterly TDS returns using RPU and FVU utilities, handle correction statements, and download and issue Form 16 and Form 16A certificates from the TRACES portal.
programs.eligibility: Commerce students, tax interns, accountants, finance executives
programs.batchTiming: Morning: 9:00 AM – 11:00 AM | Evening: 5:30 PM – 7:30 PM
programs.certificateInfo: YLCC Certified Withholding Tax & TDS Specialist

modules.title: TDS & TCS Sectional Law & Accounting Entries
topics: Recording business vouchers with accurate TDS deductions (194C, 194J, 194I, 194A, 194H)
Understanding Section 194Q (purchase of goods) vs Section 206C(1H) (TCS on sales)
Threshold limits, PAN validation, lower-deduction certificates (Section 197)
Monthly tax liability calculation and Challan 281 e-payment workflow

modules.title: Quarterly TDS/TCS Return Preparation
topics: Form 24Q (Salary TDS) salary annexure preparation and validation
Form 26Q (Non-salary domestic TDS) challan and deductee mapping
Form 27EQ (TCS returns) data compilation and CSI file verification
Using official RPU and FVU software tools to generate validated return files

modules.title: TRACES Portal Operations & Certificate Issuance
topics: TRACES portal registration, login, and challan status verification
Requesting and issuing Form 16A (non-salary) and Form 16 Part A & B (salary)
Downloading Conso file and filing TDS Correction Statements (C1, C2, C3, C5)
Handling TDS default notices, late fee computation, and interest settlement

learningOutcomes: Complete mastery over all domestic TDS and TCS deduction thresholds and rates
Confidence to prepare and file quarterly Forms 24Q, 26Q, and 27EQ using government FVU tools
Seamless operation on the TRACES portal for certificate issuance and default resolution
High-value consulting skill for corporate payroll and tax compliance desks

programs.seoDescription: Learn practical TDS and TCS accounting, monthly portal payments, quarterly return filing Form 24Q/26Q, and Form 16/16A issuance at YLCC.

programs.title: Corporate Payroll Management & Statutory Compliance
programs.shortDescription: Manage complete salary structures, duty/attendance records, overtime, statutory bonus, gratuity, payroll taxes, Labour Law compliance, and ESI/PF transactions.
programs.detailedDescription: Payroll accounting is a vital bridge between HR and finance. This course teaches how to build competitive and tax-optimized salary structures (Basic, HRA, Special Allowance, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax). You will maintain daily attendance and biometric shift logs, compute overtime, calculate annual statutory bonus and gratuity liabilities, generate monthly pay-slips and salary registers in accordance with Indian Labour Laws, and execute monthly returns for EPF (Electronic Challan-cum-Return - ECR) and ESIC on official government portals.
programs.eligibility: Commerce graduates, HR executives, accountants, payroll administrators
programs.facultyName: CS Meenakshi Sharma (Labour Law & Payroll Specialist)
programs.batchTiming: Morning: 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM | Evening: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM
programs.certificateInfo: YLCC Certified Corporate Payroll & Labour Compliance Executive

modules.title: Salary Structure Architecture & Attendance Control
topics: Structuring CTC: Basic, DA, HRA, Conveyance, Medical, and Special Allowances
Biometric attendance tracking, duty hours, leaves, and Loss of Pay (LOP) calculations
Overtime (OT) rate calculation under the Factories Act and Shops & Establishments Act
Advance salary, loan deductions, and expense reimbursements

modules.title: Statutory Benefits & Labour Law Considerations
topics: Payment of Bonus Act: eligibility, allocable surplus, and bonus calculation formula
Payment of Gratuity Act: eligibility criteria, calculation formula, and provisioning
State Professional Tax slabs, applicability, and monthly deduction entries
Labour welfare fund (LWF) contributions and statutory register maintenance

modules.title: EPF, ESIC Portals & Monthly Salary Generation
topics: EPF wage ceiling rules, employee (12%) & employer contribution break-up
Generating EPF Electronic Challan-cum-Return (ECR) and online payment
ESIC eligibility (₹21,000 ceiling), monthly contribution (0.75% & 3.25%) filing
Automated monthly salary sheet generation and bank disbursement text files

learningOutcomes: Design fully compliant corporate salary structures that optimize employee take-home pay
Generate monthly pay registers, salary slips, and bank transfer advice without discrepancies
Execute monthly EPF and ESIC return filing and online payment workflows on portal
Handle end-to-end full & final (F&F) settlement calculations for departing employees

programs.seoDescription: Practical corporate payroll training: salary structures, attendance, overtime, bonus, gratuity, Labour Law compliance, EPF and ESIC monthly filing at YLCC.

programs.title: Cost Accounting & Industrial Inventory Control
programs.shortDescription: Master stock maintenance, negative inventory alerts, automatic purchase orders, manufacturing costing, builder site costing, government tender costing, and job-worker cost control.
programs.detailedDescription: Manufacturing companies, contractors, and multi-unit businesses rely on precise cost accounting to remain profitable. This course equips you with advanced techniques to maintain accurate inventory, eliminate negative stock anomalies, and configure automated purchase-order triggers based on reorder levels. You will calculate unit manufacturing costs for own-brand products, prepare site-wise costing for construction projects and government tenders (roads, drains, bridges), and manage costing for contract vendors (e.g. Britannia / Parle-G model) and outsourced job-workers.
programs.eligibility: Commerce graduates, cost accountants, factory managers, business proprietors
programs.batchTiming: Morning: 8:30 AM – 10:30 AM | Afternoon: 2:00 PM – 4:00 PM

modules.title: Manufacturing Costing & Own-Brand Economics

Allocation of direct labour, factory overheads, and machine-hour rates
Accurate unit cost calculation for own-brand manufacturing operations
Vendor contract costing: Taken vs Given contracts (Britannia / Parle-G biscuit model)

modules.title: Site-Wise Construction & Government Tender Costing
topics: Site-wise costing for builders and multi-location real estate projects
Government thekedar (contractor for roads, bridges, and bhavans) site costing
Tender-wise cost estimation, running account (RA) bill preparation, and retention money
Job-worker material issuance, processing loss, and conversion cost control

learningOutcomes: Accurately calculate unit manufacturing cost including direct material, labour, and overheads
Manage complex multi-site construction and government contractor project accounts
Automate purchase orders and inventory control to stop inventory pilferage and capital blockage
Maintain strict control over job-worker raw material movement and processing losses

programs.title: Advanced Excel & Corporate Excel 365 Mastery
programs.shortDescription: Master 250+ Excel 365 formulas, Power Query, 500+ troubleshooting techniques, 250+ corporate interview challenges, and dynamic automated MIS dashboards.
programs.detailedDescription: Advanced Excel is the indispensable operating system of modern finance and corporate management. This intensive program moves beyond basic spreadsheets into corporate-grade Excel 365 mastery. You will master 250+ modern formulas including dynamic arrays (XLOOKUP, FILTER, UNIQUE, SORTBY, LET, LAMBDA), solve 500+ common workplace spreadsheet troubleshooting challenges, tackle 250+ real accounting interview questions, and build fully automated executive MIS dashboards that update with a single click.

projects.title: Hospital Business Accounting & Patient Billing System

projects.detailedDescription: In this practical project, students manage the complete financial accounts of "Jeevandhara Multi-Specialty Hospital". You will handle patient admission deposits, OPD consultation billing, pharmacy dispensary stock tracking, doctor visiting fees vs revenue-sharing agreements, and reconciliation of cashless mediclaim receivables from Third Party Administrators (TPAs).
skillsCovered: IPD / OPD Billing Structures
Doctor Revenue Sharing (TDS 194J)
Pharmacy Inventory & Batch Control
TPA Insurance Claims Reconciliation
Medical Equipment Capitalization & AMC Bookings

Accurately withhold TDS under Section 194J on doctor visiting fees and surgical sharing

The accounts manager must ensure live billing, prevent medicine expiry losses, and reconcile insurance settlements.
tasksToComplete: Record daily OPD cash receipts and IPD admission advance vouchers
Process monthly doctor consultancy bills with TDS deduction under 194J
Reconcile pharmacy medicine purchases, credit terms, and near-expiry stock returns

projects.title: Freight Logistics & Fleet Transport Management Accounting

projects.detailedDescription: Transport and logistics businesses handle thousands of trips across states with cash advances, fuel slips, toll charges, and broker commissions. testimonials.quote: Before joining YLCC, I had completed B.Com but had never seen an actual GST invoice, let alone filed a GSTR-3B return. At YLCC, practicing on actual bills from 16 different businesses gave me the real experience of someone with 2 years on the job. Within three weeks of finishing, I cleared my interview with complete confidence.

The TDS return filing module using actual NSDL RPU software and TRACES portal training is unmatched anywhere else. I was able to handle quarterly Form 26Q and Form 24Q filing right from my first week at the CA firm without needing any supervision.

The 250+ Excel formulas and real CMA project training changed my career trajectory. Learning how banks evaluate Drawing Power and building automated hospital billing sheets in Excel 365 gave me practical skills that directly doubled my value in corporate interviews.

YLCC does not teach bookish definitions; they teach actual corporate desk work. The hotel business accounting project and internal audit checklists enabled me to step straight into an Accounts Manager role and monitor debtors cycles effectively.

faqs.question: How is YLCC different from ordinary computer training institutes?
faqs.answer: YLCC is exclusively a commerce and professional accounting training institute—we do not teach coding or general basic computer courses. Every training topic is grounded in actual business documents: sales registers, tax invoices, bank stock statements, E-way bills, TDS certificates, and government portals. Students work on authentic practical projects across 16 different business industries (Hospitals, Hotels, Logistics, Builders, Government Contractors, FMCG, etc.).

faqs.question: What educational qualification is required to enroll?
faqs.answer: Anyone with a commerce background—including Class 12th Commerce students, B.Com, BBA, M.Com, MBA Finance graduates, CA/CS inter students, as well as working accountants and business owners looking to master their books—is welcome. Prior computer experience is not required as we start from live voucher feeding and build up to advanced audits.

faqs.question: What are the 16 Multi-Business Practical Projects?
faqs.answer: The 16 practical projects simulate complete financial years for real-world businesses: Hospital patient billing, College student fee management, Freight transport logistics, Automobile service centres, Boutique hotels, FMCG wholesale distribution, live GST B2B/B2C filings, Corporate TDS/TCS quarterly compliance, Banking CC Limit/CMA proposals, Corporate payroll for 100+ employees, Furniture showroom custom costing, Architect project billing, Real estate builder site costing, Job-worker inventory control, Government thekedar infrastructure tender costing, and Multi-branch franchise chain accounting (Javed Habib model).

faqs.question: Do I get a verified certificate upon course completion?
faqs.answer: Yes, YLCC issues practical skill completion certificates verifying hands-on competence in accounting operations, GST, TDS/TCS, Payroll, and Advanced Excel. Certificates are awarded upon successful evaluation of your practical case study ledgers. We also offer career guidance, resume structuring for finance desks, and interview preparation covering 250+ real corporate accounting interview questions.

faqs.question: What batch options are available for working professionals and college students?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible batch schedules: Early Morning (7:30 AM – 9:30 AM), Regular Morning (10:00 AM – 12:00 PM), Evening (5:00 PM – 7:00 PM & 6:30 PM – 8:30 PM), and Weekend Executive Cohorts (Saturday & Sunday). Batches are strictly capped at 15–20 students to guarantee personalized 1-on-1 practical ledger guidance.

faqs.question: Which software tools are taught during the courses?
faqs.answer: Students gain hands-on proficiency in Tally Prime 4.0 (with multi-user and multi-cost-center features), Busy Accounting Software, Microsoft Excel 365 (including Power Query, Dynamic Arrays, and MIS modeling), the official GST Portal and GST Offline Tool, the NSDL RPU and FVU e-TDS return utilities, TRACES Portal, and the Unified EPF and ESIC compliance portals.
